activity.imageHint: Loading asks {{from}}, which sees your IP address
activity.label: {{network}} profile and posts
activity.source: Loaded from {{hosts}}, which saw this device’s IP address. What the account says, not part of the proof.

add.askingSigner: Asking your signer which identity it holds…
add.attestedAbout: A company vouches that you logged in to this account. Your contacts see who vouches.
add.checking: Checking it the way your contacts will…
add.experimental: Experimental: not yet tested with every tool.
add.keyAbout: Only the holder of this key can make this proof.
add.lead: Optional. Nothing is shared until you choose a contact in a chat.
add.linkable: Sharing the same identity with several contacts lets them know it is the same person.
add.none: No kind of identity can be added in this app yet.
add.redirectHint: {{provider}} will ask you to log in. It then vouches for the account to Ghostly with a signed token; your password never reaches Ghostly.

contact.attested: {{attester}} says this account logged in: only as trustworthy as {{attester}}.
contact.attestedByProvider: The provider says this account logged in: only as trustworthy as it.
contact.holderOnly: Only the holder of this key could have made this proof.
contact.lead: Shared in this chat only. Not proof of who they are.
contact.lookupNote: A public profile is looked up only when you ask; the servers asked learn which identity you looked up.
contact.name: Name
contact.recheckNote: Check again looks for a revocation by its owner.
contact.recheckNoteRepeat: Check again looks for a revocation by its owner and repeats the check.
contact.revoked: {{status}}: its owner removed it and published a revocation
contact.shareYours: Share yours from the + in the chat.
contact.tapHint: Tap a card to see how it was checked.
contact.title: Identities with {{name}}

did.expired: Expired: not listed until you renew it
did.failed: Could not publish: {{error}}. Trying again in a few minutes.
did.hint: An identifier for this profile that anyone can look up (a W3C DID, did:dht). It has a key of its own: no chat uses it, so it ties none of them together.
did.listTitle: List identities publicly in my DID
did.none: No identity to list yet. Nostr keys, domains, OpenPGP keys, Bitcoin addresses and GitHub or GitLab accounts can be listed once you add them.
did.offline: Not published while the network is off.
did.published: Published {{time}}. It goes out again every hour while the app runs.
did.title: Public DID
did.warning: Anything listed here is public to everyone, for good: anyone with your DID sees it, and some resolvers keep copies even after you take it out. Chats never need it. Leave these off to share each identity with one contact at a time.

face.hint: Name and photo in your chat list. Only on this device.
face.lapsed: That profile's proof no longer holds, so their Ghostly name is back.
face.nickname: Your nickname “{{nickname}}” stays; the photo is theirs.
face.title: Show as

ghostly.addHint: Prove that you hold a Nostr key, a domain or an account, then show it to the contacts you choose, one chat at a time.
ghostly.chosenChats: Shown only in the chats you choose
ghostly.doneOnly: Only your Ghostly identity is shared
ghostly.emptyHint: No other identities yet. Choose New to prove that you hold a Nostr key, a domain or an account, then show it to the contacts you choose, one chat at a time.
ghostly.explain: Your Ghostly identity is what contacts see unless you share another: your name and picture, and a key pair made for each chat, so no key ties your chats together.
ghostly.hintSees: {{contact}} sees your Ghostly identity, {{name}}, and this chat's key {{key}}.
ghostly.keysHint: Open a chat's Identities to see the key it uses there.
ghostly.nameAsSaid: Name and picture as they sent them; they are not a proof.
ghostly.notVerifiedExplain: You have not compared codes with them yet; the chat's connection panel offers it.
ghostly.theirDefault: What they show you by default
ghostly.verifiedExplain: You compared codes with them: their key is the one you verified.

mine.attested: {{attester}} says this account logged in: that is only as trustworthy as {{attester}}.
mine.attestedByProvider: The provider says this account logged in: that is only as trustworthy as the provider.
mine.cannotAdd: No identity can be added on this device.
mine.checkedWhenMade: Checked when it was made, the way your contacts check it. It does not prove who a person is.
mine.removeHint: Stops sharing it everywhere and publishes a revocation.
mine.removeNote: Contacts you shared it with are told it is no longer shared, and a revocation is published so they can see it even if you never reconnect. A copy they kept cannot be erased.
mine.renewHint: Add it again to renew it; then remove this one.
mine.shareHint: Share it from a chat’s Identities, one contact at a time.
mine.takeDownFailed: What it published could not be taken down. You can remove the proof without it: contacts still see it revoked.
mine.title: Yours

nostr.addOwn: Add a Nostr identity under Identities to see your own profile and follows here.
nostr.addToCompare: Add a Nostr identity to your profile to compare follow lists.
nostr.autoLoadHint: When a contact's Nostr proof is verified, and again when it is a day old. Off: only when you press Load profile.
nostr.contactNote: Nostr, from this key. Loading asks the relays in your profile ({{relays}}), which learn your IP address and that you looked this key up. Everything below is what {{name}} published about themselves.
nostr.contactNoteCompact: Loading asks your relays ({{relays}}), which learn your IP address and this key. It is what {{name}} published about themselves.
nostr.fieldsNote: An emptied field is removed from your profile; fields Ghostly does not show (a Lightning address, a banner) stay as they are.
nostr.followList: Your follow list, {{count}} accounts, replaced as a whole.
nostr.followListOne: Your follow list, 1 account, replaced as a whole.
nostr.followsSource: Follows {{when}}; their list as of {{time}}. A follow is not trust, and none of this is checked against anyone else.
nostr.followsYouHint: (their list names your key, or not)
nostr.hidden: {{count}} notes hidden by your mute list.
nostr.hiddenOne: 1 note hidden by your mute list.
nostr.loadFirst: Load your profile first so fields you do not edit here are kept as they are.
nostr.loadOwnHint: Load your own follow list to see who you both follow.
nostr.mute: Mute list: {{list}}. Applied to contacts' notes here.
nostr.mutePrivate: Mute list: {{list}}; its private part is not read. Applied to contacts' notes here.
nostr.muted: You muted this key on Nostr: their notes stay hidden.
nostr.name: Name
nostr.nip05Unchecked: (NIP-05, as written by them, not checked)
nostr.notesSource: Notes {{when}}. Newest first, as the relays hold them; no ranking.
nostr.pictureHost: Their picture is on a host Ghostly does not fetch from.
nostr.postPlaceholder: What is on your mind? This will be public.
nostr.profileNone: No profile published under this key.
nostr.profileSource: Profile {{when}}. Self-described; a manual name for this chat wins over it.
nostr.profileSourceChanged: Profile {{when}}, changed by them {{time}}. Self-described; a manual name for this chat wins over it.
nostr.publishHint: Post notes, follow and unfollow, update your profile, through your own signer. Every action is shown and confirmed first; everything published is public.
nostr.relaysHint: Asked for contacts' profiles, follows and notes, and sent what you publish. Each one learns your IP address and which keys you look up. Nothing is asked until you load something.

page.intro: Optional proofs that you also hold another identity (a Nostr key, a domain, an account). You choose, one chat at a time, who sees them.

picker.stopNote: Stopping tells {{contact}}; a copy they kept stays.

profile.failed: The public profile could not be loaded from {{from}}. It is asked again later.
profile.none: No public profile on {{network}} for this identity.
profile.pictureMiss: The profile’s picture is not shown: {{reason}}.
profile.sourceAsked: Asked {{from}} {{time}}. Asking told that server this device’s IP address.
profile.sourceFound: Loaded from {{from}} {{time}}. What the account says about itself, not part of the proof. Asking told that server this device’s IP address.
